test_instructions: Launch the already-built x64 Debug PowerToys executable and exercise the affected title-bar windows in a CJK Windows display-language or app-language environment.

Open Environment Variables, File Locksmith, Hosts File Editor, Shortcut Guide, Registry Preview, and the Settings shortcut-conflict dialog; verify each opens without the Microsoft.UI.Windowing.dll startup crash and shows a non-empty title.
Repeat under elevated and non-elevated runner states where applicable, including Environment Variables administrator-launch settings, and close/reopen each window several times.
